Method of Attack: Redirecting visitors to fake browser update prompts that install malware
Using TDS for midpoint bounce to deliver malware, historically used by ransomware gangs for initial access
Attack Vector: Injection of malicious redirection scripts into HTML of vulnerable sites
Use of blackhat SEO to generate traffic
Affiliate traffic forwarding to TDS servers
Indicators of Compromise: Over 70,000 compromised sites controlled by VexTrio
Traffic redirected through VexTrio TDS servers
Push notifications masquerading as system warnings or AV alerts
Date of Discovery: SocGholish collaboration since at least April 2022
